judge.rationale: The core validation implementation in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` is well-written, properly compiling static schemas at registration time, caching dynamic schemas via a `WeakMap`, and formatting error messages without leaking offending values. However, the candidate appears to have stopped partway through its own Definition of Done, leaving `.lore/dod.md` committed in the repository and skipping several explicit acceptance criteria. Specifically, the candidate failed to update `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts`. It also missed the test pinning the `Unknown tool: <name>` throw, put the orchestrator tool-loop test into a new `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file instead of `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and unnecessarily bumped the version in `package.json`.
